title: incident-bot / slo-toolkit: runbook autodiagnostics enhancements and on-call helper utilities
author: Maya Patel
body:
Summary:
Improve incident-bot and slo-toolkit integration to provide richer, faster runbook auto-diagnostics and on-call helper utilities. This PR adds heuristics for SLO-to-runbook correlation, enriches diagnostic suggestions with recent deploys and telemetry links, and introduces a small on-call helper library used by the bot to surface actionable next steps.

Motivation and context:
- On several recent incidents we found teams spend time manually correlating SLO violations to runbooks and recent deploys.
- The incident-bot previously surfaced candidate runbooks but lacked confidence signals and quick links to relevant telemetry and deploy metadata.
- This change reduces mean time to remediation by providing prioritized, evidence-backed runbook suggestions and a compact set of on-call helpers (summaries, link shortcuts, and suggested commands).

What this PR does (high level):
- SLO correlation: add additional matching heuristics (label-based, metric-signature matching, and latency/error signature fingerprinting) that increase runbook match precision.
- Evidence enrichment: attach top-3 relevant traces, recent deploy IDs (last 24h), and relevant dashboard links to each suggested runbook.
- Priority scoring: implement a simple priority score combining SLO impact, recent regressions, and confidence from signature matches.
- On-call helpers: new utilities for compact runbook summaries, quicklinks (console, traces, logs), and a one-click '‘notify on-call’ flow used by incident-bot messages.
- UX/templating: small templating updates so suggested actions are human-friendly and include pre-populated Slack/Teams message templates.
- Tests: unit tests for heuristics and integration tests exercising the enriched payloads.

Checklist:
- [x] Add new correlation heuristics (unit tested)
- [x] Attach telemetry and deploy evidence (integration tests)
- [x] Add on-call helper utilities and templates
- [x] Update incident-bot message format and backwards-compatible feature flag
- [x] Add SLO toolkit helpers for runbook scoring
- [x] Docs: short ops-runbook note + examples

Commits (summary):
- 1a2b3c4: feat(slo-toolkit): add runbook correlation heuristics (label + signature matching)
- 2b3c4d5: feat(incident-bot): attach telemetry & deploy evidence to suggestions
- 3c4d5e6: feat(oncall-utils): compact summaries and quicklink helpers
- 4d5e6f7: test: add unit/integration tests for new heuristics and payloads
- 5e6f7g8: docs: add runbook autodiagnostics README and example templates

Files changed (high level):
- services/incident-bot/src/suggestions/runbook_matcher.py (new heuristics)
- services/incident-bot/src/formatters/compact_summary.py (new helper)
- services/incident-bot/templates/suggestion_message.tpl (message updates)
- libs/slo-toolkit/src/runbook_scoring.py (scoring logic)
- libs/slo-toolkit/tests/test_runbook_scoring.py
- docs/ops/runbook-autodiagnostics.md
- infra/feature-flags/feature_flags.yaml (add: enable_runbook_autodiags)

Testing and CI:
- Added unit tests for new matcher functions and scoring (libs/slo-toolkit tests).
- Integration tests in incident-bot verify messages include top-3 evidence links and deploy IDs.
- CI: initial pipeline failed flakily in integration step (timeout on test harness). Reran and all checks passed.

CI status: pass

Review conversation (high level):
- Ethan Li: Requested stronger isolation of feature flag checks so older bots don't break on message schema changes. Suggested adding a compatibility shim.
- Maya Patel: Responded with implementation that gates the enriched payload behind enable_runbook_autodiags and retains legacy message keys when flag is off. Added tests to ensure backward compatibility.
- Sofia Martinez: Asked for telemetry link TTL (we keep only last 7 days by default) and a small opt-out via org policy. Implemented configurable window with sane default.
- Jonah Klein: Approved after verifying tests and running a small canary in staging.

Merge notes:
- Merge method: squash
- Merged by: Jonah Klein
- Post-merge: created a small follow-up task (ENG-4782) to add analytics tracking for suggestion acceptance rate.

Release notes:
- incident-bot: richer runbook suggestions with telemetry & deploy context, improved matching heuristics, on-call helper utilities, and a feature-flag to opt-in.

Related work / linked tickets:
- Linear: ENG-4481, SRE-221, ENG-4710

Backward compatibility and rollout plan:
- Feature gated behind enable_runbook_autodiags.
- Rollout steps: enable in staging, run a 48-hour canary for high-SLO services, enable org-by-org.
- No breaking changes expected when flag is off.

Operational notes:
- Monitoring: added metrics for suggestion_count, suggestion_accepted, match_confidence_histogram.
- Alerts: added a low-severity alert if suggestion_accepted_rate drops > 50% over 24h after rollout (ENG-4783).

If you want to test quickly in dev:
1) flip feature flag in infra/feature-flags/feature_flags.yaml to true for your org id
2) trigger the incident-bot test harness: tools/ci/run_incident_bot_integration.sh --suite runbook-autodiags
3) inspect staging slack channel #incident-bot-staging for enriched messages

End of PR description.
release_notes: incident-bot: richer runbook suggestions with telemetry & deploy context; improved matching heuristics; on-call helper utilities; gated feature flag enable_runbook_autodiags
notes_after_merge: Follow-up ENG-4782 added to track acceptance rate; analytics dashboard ticket created; feature scheduled for staged rollout next week.
